triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pricing.fn_set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pricing'
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

constraints.name: ck_price_validities_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (price_id WITH =, tstzrange(valid_from, valid_until, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ((NOT is_cancelled)) DEFERRABLE

constraints.name: ck_price_validities_oferta
constraints.definition: CHECK (((precio_oferta IS NULL) OR ((precio_oferta > (0)::numeric) AND (precio_oferta < precio_regular))))

constraints.name: fk_price_validities_price_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (price_id) REFERENCES prices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ck_prices_target
constraints.definition: CHECK (((product_id IS NOT NULL) <> (sku IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: uq_prices_target_channel
constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (product_id, sku, channel_id)

notes: Las consultas de catalog y pricing son transacciones separadas; revalidar ambas antes de cualquier lote nuevo.
SET LOCAL ROLE acredita rol efectivo, no login individual de seed_vera.
No se ejecuto DML, DDL ni ensayo de escritura con ROLLBACK.
RLS deshabilitado en pricing; anon/authenticated sin USAGE del schema ni SELECT de tablas. No se modificaron grants ni exposicion Data API.

Correccion P0: sku_identity tiene exactamente un propietario. Variante: variant_id y product_id NULL; el padre se resuelve mediante variants.product_id. Los seis IDs ya existian; no se insertaron identidades.

identity_sql_regression.fixture_description: CTE de solo lectura con los IDs observados; estados ACTIVO/ACTIVA simulados, no modificados en Catalogo.
identity_sql_regression.reproducible_sql:
-- DATA-003 / #13. Inspeccion autorizada de referencias, sin JOIN cross-schema.
-- Se ejecuta aparte con el acceso MCP de lectura; no ampliar permisos de po_pricing_seed.
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, catalog;

WITH fixture_products AS (
 SELECT id,nombre,sku_base,tiene_variantes,'ACTIVO'::text AS estado,catalog_version
 FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[{"id":"08f2c67c-d79a-3e61-c7ee-0262885f68e7","estado":"BORRADOR","nombre":"Puma Ultra Play","sku_base":"PUM-ULP-BASE","catalog_version":0,"tiene_variantes":true},{"id":"32a4172c-81b2-b643-1d0f-ae66f627f2ef","estado":"BORRADOR","nombre":"adidas Entrada 22","sku_base":"ADI-ENT22-BASE","catalog_version":0,"tiene_variantes":true},{"id":"abab3400-46eb-58f7-78d5-8204418b60d9","estado":"BORRADOR","nombre":"Nike Pitch","sku_base":"NIK-PITCH-05","catalog_version":0,"tiene_variantes":false},{"id":"abaf9767-7431-9b50-495c-aeb880dc3055","estado":"BORRADOR","nombre":"adidas Runfalcon 3.0","sku_base":"ADI-RF3-BASE","catalog_version":0,"tiene_variantes":true},{"id":"fedeecfb-c7f5-56cf-c31b-9cdf10b47058","estado":"BORRADOR","nombre":"Nike Revolution 7","sku_base":"NIK-REV7-BASE","catalog_version":0,"tiene_variantes":true}]'::jsonb)
 AS p(id uuid,nombre text,sku_base text,tiene_variantes boolean,catalog_version bigint)
), fixture_variants AS (
 SELECT id,product_id,sku,'ACTIVA'::text AS estado,catalog_version
 FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[{"id":"35133a17-114a-381e-090a-87446d5fc701","sku":"ADI-ENT22-AZU-M","estado":"BORRADOR","product_id":"32a4172c-81b2-b643-1d0f-ae66f627f2ef","catalog_version":0},{"id":"437853de-9b59-6b0b-5b26-ccd51e2e062b","sku":"NIK-REV7-NEG-42","estado":"BORRADOR","product_id":"fedeecfb-c7f5-56cf-c31b-9cdf10b47058","catalog_version":0},{"id":"532ffc0d-d209-2b48-6506-e94f62026e17","sku":"ADI-RF3-GRI-38","estado":"BORRADOR","product_id":"abaf9767-7431-9b50-495c-aeb880dc3055","catalog_version":0},{"id":"9ba54bda-2686-8e3b-41c6-68b6efa16338","sku":"PUM-ULP-NEG-42","estado":"BORRADOR","product_id":"08f2c67c-d79a-3e61-c7ee-0262885f68e7","catalog_version":0},{"id":"9df1c63b-f475-5ea4-fab4-cf2bb36120ae","sku":"NIK-REV7-NEG-41","estado":"BORRADOR","product_id":"fedeecfb-c7f5-56cf-c31b-9cdf10b47058","catalog_version":0},{"id":"f1bd0fad-819b-b0fd-b5b1-53bb36fd468f","sku":"ADI-RF3-GRI-39","estado":"BORRADOR","product_id":"abaf9767-7431-9b50-495c-aeb880dc3055","catalog_version":0}]'::jsonb)
 AS v(id uuid,product_id uuid,sku text,catalog_version bigint)
), fixture_identities AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[{"id":"1fb83549-de75-4489-a51f-9224648b3b83","sku":"ADI-ENT22-AZU-M","product_id":null,"variant_id":"35133a17-114a-381e-090a-87446d5fc701"},{"id":"fe8a75a1-d44a-41da-b8ba-2bfed14a6349","sku":"ADI-ENT22-BASE","product_id":"32a4172c-81b2-b643-1d0f-ae66f627f2ef","variant_id":null},{"id":"d52d71f9-25e8-4e95-8b98-fad87974f403","sku":"ADI-RF3-BASE","product_id":"abaf9767-7431-9b50-495c-aeb880dc3055","variant_id":null},{"id":"5fbdfbb6-2c5d-44fb-a896-27e2e44405c9","sku":"ADI-RF3-GRI-38","product_id":null,"variant_id":"532ffc0d-d209-2b48-6506-e94f62026e17"},{"id":"43ba45b9-c161-4387-a1c9-db2b1f17afc2","sku":"ADI-RF3-GRI-39","product_id":null,"variant_id":"f1bd0fad-819b-b0fd-b5b1-53bb36fd468f"},{"id":"eb4d35ac-41c0-4e6e-a059-5dc35d850a57","sku":"NIK-PITCH-05","product_id":"abab3400-46eb-58f7-78d5-8204418b60d9","variant_id":null},{"id":"3aa8160e-55a5-4f89-abd6-73abf2dc4e5f","sku":"NIK-REV7-BASE","product_id":"fedeecfb-c7f5-56cf-c31b-9cdf10b47058","variant_id":null},{"id":"0265b4f7-4ca3-455c-a416-de32eb341494","sku":"NIK-REV7-NEG-41","product_id":null,"variant_id":"9df1c63b-f475-5ea4-fab4-cf2bb36120ae"},{"id":"0ece3ef9-cede-4159-85b5-1768b63ab748","sku":"NIK-REV7-NEG-42","product_id":null,"variant_id":"437853de-9b59-6b0b-5b26-ccd51e2e062b"},{"id":"48951138-c5b2-41e3-9935-3f3b9bec2d12","sku":"PUM-ULP-BASE","product_id":"08f2c67c-d79a-3e61-c7ee-0262885f68e7","variant_id":null},{"id":"72c5c4f2-f9cb-40c1-a017-b48a0a4b79cb","sku":"PUM-ULP-NEG-42","product_id":null,"variant_id":"9ba54bda-2686-8e3b-41c6-68b6efa16338"}]'::jsonb)
 AS s(id uuid,sku text,product_id uuid,variant_id uuid)
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'captured_at', now(), 'mode', 'READ_ONLY',
  'session_user', session_user, 'effective_role', current_user,
  'transaction_read_only', current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
  'products', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', p.id, 'nombre', p.nombre, 'sku_base', p.sku_base,
    'tiene_variantes', p.tiene_variantes, 'estado', p.estado,
    'catalog_version', p.catalog_version) ORDER BY p.id) FROM fixture_products p),
  'variants', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v.id, 'product_id', v.product_id, 'sku', v.sku,
    'estado', v.estado, 'catalog_version', v.catalog_version) ORDER BY v.id)
    FROM fixture_variants v),
  'sku_identities', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', s.id, 'sku', s.sku, 'product_id', s.product_id, 'variant_id', s.variant_id)
    ORDER BY s.sku) FROM fixture_identities s),
  'published_sellable_skus', (SELECT count(*)
    FROM (
      SELECT s.id FROM fixture_identities s
      JOIN fixture_products p ON p.id = s.product_id
      WHERE s.variant_id IS NULL AND s.sku = p.sku_base
        AND NOT p.tiene_variantes AND p.estado = 'ACTIVO'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT s.id FROM fixture_identities s
      JOIN fixture_variants v ON v.id = s.variant_id AND v.sku = s.sku
      JOIN fixture_products p ON p.id = v.product_id
      WHERE s.product_id IS NULL AND p.tiene_variantes
        AND p.estado = 'ACTIVO' AND v.estado = 'ACTIVA'
    ) published),
  'variants_without_identity', (SELECT count(*) FROM fixture_variants v
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixture_identities s
      WHERE s.sku = v.sku AND s.variant_id = v.id AND s.product_id IS NULL))
) AS audit;
COMMIT;
